protocol.checkpoint_rule: never evaluate a dataset with a prompt learner fitted on itself (upstream zero-shot convention)
protocol.single_config: no seed and no K loop; one row per (dataset, category)
protocol.dumped_map: per-image 37x37 patch field (sim_abnormal + 1 - sim_normal)/2, the official formula before the official bilinear upsampling to 518
protocol.rect: whole original image, [0,1]x[0,1]: utils.get_transform resizes to (518,518) and CenterCrop(518) is then a no-op
